name: Competitive Landscape
question: Is the company gaining or losing ground against current competitors and credible entrants, and is its advantage structural or temporary?

signals.description: Named-competitor set and changes to it (baseline). Webset entity:"company" with criteria; monitor search behavior catches entrants.
Relative web traffic and trajectory: company entity webTraffic (+ similarweb connector), compared across the competitor Webset

recipe.query_template: web traffic level and trajectory of {company} compared against {competitors}
{company} OR {competitors} wins contract OR switches from

signals.description: Pricing-power evidence: price increases sticking vs discounting spirals
Product-comparison verdicts in trade press and reviews
Patent/IP disputes with competitors; litigation coverage
New-entrant funding in the category (fiber connector / news)

grade_anchors.A: Share gains confirmed by third parties; pricing power demonstrated; entrants struggling.
grade_anchors.C: Holding share in a commoditizing category; wins and losses roughly balanced; advantage explainable but eroding.
grade_anchors.F: Verified customer exodus, forced discounting, or a structurally superior substitute scaling unchecked.

false_signals.description: "Market leadership" claimed in a market defined so narrowly (or so broadly) it's meaningless. Compare company TAM claims vs independent market-size estimates.

recipe.query_template: {company} TAM OR market size claims compared against independent market-size estimates

false_signals.description: Self-published comparisons that independent reviews contradict. Independence rule enforced.

recipe.query_template: {company} benchmark claims contradicted by independent review

false_signals.description: "Growth" bought with unsustainable discounts/incentives (cross-check F9 unit economics).

recipe.query_template: {company} growth driven by unsustainable discounts OR incentives, cross-checked against unit economics

evidence_policy.notes: Competitor set comes from the company's competitor Webset (created at report time); {competitors} placeholders resolve from it.
